description.zh: 黑名单版本versioncode列表，英文逗号分隔，黑白名单不能同时设置。
description.en: The list of blacklisted version codes, separated by commas. Blacklists and whitelists cannot be configured at the same time in Settings.

description.zh: 白名单版本versioncode列表，英文逗号分隔，黑白名单不能同时设置。
description.en: The list of whitelisted version codes, separated by commas. Blacklists and whitelists cannot be configured at the same time in Settings.

title.zh: 更新应用版本的版本的黑白名单
title.en: Update blacklists and whitelists of an application version

descriptions.zh: 例如，若配置某个应用版本，只有哪些低版本的应用版本才能升级到此版本时，可以设置版本白名单。黑白名单不能同时设置。
descriptions.en: For example, if you want to configure an application version so that only specific earlier versions can be upgraded to this version, you can configure a version whitelist in Settings. Blacklists and whitelists cannot be configured at the same time.
